source_title: Phoebe Bridgers Releases 'Live at Madison Square Garden' EP via Tidal
source_excerpt:
Cellphones might have been barred from Phoebe Bridgers ’ Madison Square Garden show in June, but fans can revisit the singer’s concert at the arena thanks to a new live EP.
Live at Madison Square Garden , available to download exclusively via Tidal , features five Lost Weekend songs that Bridgers performed at the “World’s Most Famous Arena” before the release of her new album. The EP includes tracks like the single “Lost Boys”and “Long Lost Weekend,” an extended version of the title track.
Non- Tidal users can also download the EP, which is the latest move in a partnership between the streaming service and the singer; Tidal also sponsored the MSG gig, which had a $1 ticket price but banned cellphones from capturing the show.
